title: fastTextWordEmbedding
summary: Return a compact fastText-style word embedding compatibility model.

gpu_support.notes: `fastTextWordEmbedding` constructs host wordEmbedding metadata and dense vectors; it does not use provider kernels.

description: `fastTextWordEmbedding` returns a RunMat `wordEmbedding` compatibility object with `Dimension` 300 and a compact built-in English vocabulary.
behaviors: The supported form is the zero-argument `emb = fastTextWordEmbedding` form.
The returned object exposes `Dimension` and `Vocabulary` and stores dense vectors in the same implementation-detail property used by `word2vec`, `vec2word`, and `doc2sequence`.
The compact model includes curated vectors for common examples such as `Italy - Rome + Paris`, which maps back to `France` with `vec2word`.
RunMat does not download MathWorks support packages. The full 1-million-word fastText English 16 Billion Token model remains tracked in the broader Text Analytics compatibility issue.

examples.output: `word` is `"France"` for the bundled compact model.

faqs.question: Does this include MATLAB's full pretrained fastText support-package corpus?
faqs.answer: No. RunMat currently provides a compact compatibility model so scripts can construct and use a `wordEmbedding` object. Full support-package corpus parity remains open.

faqs.question: Can the result be used with `word2vec`, `vec2word`, and `doc2sequence`?
faqs.answer: Yes. The returned object uses the same RunMat `wordEmbedding` representation as `readWordEmbedding` and `trainWordEmbedding`.

faqs.question: Does `fastTextWordEmbedding` execute on the GPU?
faqs.answer: No. It constructs host text/model metadata and dense vectors.

points: The compact model is deterministic and bundled with RunMat.
Full pretrained-corpus parity is not yet implemented.

gpu_residency: `fastTextWordEmbedding` performs host object construction and has no provider kernel.
